parsed.note_claim: Troy Lake was not sentenced to seven years but served months in prison for emissions violations on commercial vehicles, not for fixing his own truck.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Troy Lake, a 65-year-old diesel mechanic, spent seven months in federal prison for 'conspiracy to violate the Clean Air Act.'
parsed.reason: The page confirms Lake spent months rather than years in prison for working on commercial vehicles, substantiating the note's correction of the post's claims.
